settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions — Unmatched Supply
settings.text: Find answers about Unmatched Supply (formerly Unmatched Kicks), our 100% authenticity guarantee, Pan-India shipping, Instant Ship, and customer support.

settings.title: What is Unmatched Supply?
settings.text: Founded in 2022 and based in Mumbai, Unmatched Supply (formerly Unmatched Kicks) is an Indian independent resale retailer offering 100% authentic global streetwear, performance activewear, athleisure, limited-edition sneakers, and fitness supplements with fast Pan-India delivery.

settings.title: Are Unmatched Kicks and Unmatched Supply the same store?
settings.text: Yes. Unmatched Kicks rebranded to Unmatched Supply (UNMATCHEDSUPPLY) at unmatchedsupply.com while continuing to connect with our community on Instagram at @unmatchedkicks.in.

settings.title: Are all products sold at Unmatched Supply authentic?
settings.text: Yes. Every product undergoes a thorough authenticity and quality inspection at our Mumbai facility before dispatch, examining packaging, tags, materials, and construction. We do not sell counterfeit items.

settings.title: Which global brands does Unmatched Supply carry?
settings.text: We curate sought-after international streetwear, activewear, sneakers, and supplements including Gymshark, YoungLA, Alo Yoga, Fear of God Essentials, Lululemon, Stussy, Supreme, Nike Air Jordan, Nike Dunks, Yeezy, Ghost, and David Protein.

settings.title: Do you ship across India, and what is Instant Ship?
settings.text: Yes, we deliver Pan-India using tracked courier partners. Select in-stock items tagged under our Instant Ship collections are ready in our Mumbai warehouse for rapid dispatch.

settings.title: Are there any customs duties or hidden import fees?
settings.text: No. Because our products are imported and stocked in India prior to dispatch, there are zero extra customs fees upon delivery.

settings.title: How do I choose the right size?
settings.text: Most featured brands follow international US or UK sizing. Check our dedicated brand size guides or reach out to our team on WhatsApp for personalized sizing advice before placing your order.

settings.title: How can I contact Unmatched Supply customer support?
settings.text: You can message our support team on WhatsApp at +91 77100 96203 or email us at unmatchedkicks@gmail.com with your order ID and registered email for quick assistance.
